properties.message_511: On VA-42 (W Reservoir Rd) in the Town of Woodstock from Ox Rd; City Rt. 3E/W (Town of Woodstock) to Susan Ave; Rt. 9745E (Shenandoah County), motorists can expect potential delays in this area from 10/14/26 at 6:00 PM until 10/14/26 at 6:30 PM due to a parade. The north left lane, right lane, and right shoulder are closed. All south lanes are closed.
